subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep home-relative path display by default, switch agent-visible file paths to full absolute paths, or add an explicit opt-in mode for full paths?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally shorten real home paths, related fixes preserved that behavior, and the root repo policy discourages absolute paths in review replies, so automation cannot choose the product contract safely.

options.title: Keep Shorthand Default
options.body: Preserve `~/...` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME/...` for compact display while continuing to fix corrupt or non-copyable sibling-prefix cases.

options.title: Switch To Absolute Defaults
options.body: Change user-facing agent/tool path output to full absolute paths by default and update prompts, docs, and tests consistently.

options.title: Add Explicit Full-Path Mode
options.body: Keep current defaults but add a documented opt-in setting for users who need absolute path output.

recommendation.title: Keep Shorthand Default
recommendation.body: Preserve `~/...` and `$OPENCLAW_HOME/...` for compact display while continuing to fix corrupt or non-copyable sibling-prefix cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and the root reply policy make this the best available owner for the display-contract decision.
